Class DragonFlyBsdHWDiskStore

java.lang.Object
oshi.hardware.common.AbstractHWDiskStore
oshi.hardware.common.platform.unix.dragonflybsd.DragonFlyBsdHWDiskStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
HWDiskStore
@ThreadSafe public final class DragonFlyBsdHWDiskStore extends AbstractHWDiskStore
DragonFly BSD hard disk implementation. DragonFly has neither geom nor FreeBSD's iostat -x, so the statistics come from the raw struct devstat records in the kern.devstat.all sysctl. The model, serial number, size and partitions are only readable through the disk devices themselves, which need root, so they are left unknown.

  • Method Details

    • updateAttributes

      public boolean updateAttributes()
      Description copied from interface: HWDiskStore
      Make a best effort to update all the statistics about the drive without needing to recreate the drive list. This method provides for more frequent periodic updates of individual drive statistics but may be less efficient to use if updating all drives. It will not detect if a removable drive has been removed and replaced by a different drive in between method calls.
      Returns:
      True if the update was (probably) successful, false if the disk was not found

      Returns:
